data_fields.name: reputation_notice_trigger
data_fields.donor_constant: notify only when the new value differs from the old

data_fields.name: ledger_slot_count
data_fields.donor_constant: loaded from GAME_GLOBAL_VARS section, not fixed in code

best_idea: Every write to a named ledger slot passes the old and new value to that slot's watcher before the store, so the feed notice is derived from the one verified write.
decision_why: The notify-on-write shape fits the one-ledger ruling, but the notice must come from the server's verified write, and reputation and standing need one slot and one name.
acceptance: A player's standing changes by +3 from a verified turn-in; the HUD line reads once; a write that leaves the value unchanged shows nothing; a server test asserts the notice is produced from the same write that updates the ledger row.
